title: Require oRPC Error Authority
forbids: runtime ORPCTaggedError imports and runtime namespace or default effect-orpc imports outside an exact module contract.ts, plus runtime conventional contract or error imports from router or impl files except the embedded API impl.ts declaration import { contract } from './contract'
why: A module contract owns its public oRPC error constructors. Canonical named vendor imports keep that authority visible, while the native service composition law separately owns contract-to-implementer lineage.
remediate: Define and attach public tagged errors in the owning module contract.ts. Replace runtime namespace/default effect-orpc imports with canonical named imports. For conventional contract or error sources, use type-only imports; only an embedded API impl.ts may use the exact runtime declaration import { contract } from './contract'.
message: Public oRPC error constructors belong to the owning module contract.
